en.sc3000.web.anything: All identities accepted, including no identity. This pretend sign-in collects nothing.
en.sc3000.web.banner: SolidCraft 3000 will undergo no-downtime maintenance {date} from now until forever.
en.sc3000.web.change_extrude: Moved the Extrude button 3 px to the left
en.sc3000.web.change_fillet: Your fillets now sync to the cloud before they exist
en.sc3000.web.credits: Cloud credits: you have 3. Extrudes cost 1. (Just kidding, they're free.)
en.sc3000.web.fillet_outage: SolidCraft 3000 is experiencing issues. We have identified the problem and are working on a fix. For now, please limit fillets to 3 operations per hour.
en.sc3000.web.identical: These versions are identical. Both choices keep the same local design.
en.sc3000.web.offline: Offline mode detected: everything works perfectly
en.sc3000.web.outage: Scheduled outage: please enjoy this loading screen
en.sc3000.web.parsecs: Parsecs per fortnight is a speed, so every length in your design now reads 0 pc/fn: your part is standing perfectly still. Relativistic tolerances arrive in SolidCraft 3000 Ultra.
en.sc3000.web.salmon_dispatched: A friendly service salmon has been dispatched to your design.
en.sc3000.web.tip_0: Did you know? Your files are stored on your own computer. We're as surprised as you are.
en.sc3000.web.tip_1: Tip of the cloud: if something feels slow, it is probably the cloud. If nothing feels slow, that is the cloud too.
en.sc3000.web.tip_2: Tip of the cloud: Ctrl+S saves. Pressing it twice just makes the cloud feel needed.
en.sc3000.web.tip_3: Tip of the cloud: the cloud has no weather, but it does have maintenance.
en.sc3000.web.title: SolidCraft 3000
